purpose: Teach: 名声/攻める/前身/模試/近世/廃案/本州/鎖国

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、文豪の名声、章にしましたね。
lines.en: Your paper's structure is really thoughtful — the fame of literary masters, made into a chapter.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Genuine approval settling into the opening words. Steady pace with a slight lift at 'thoughtful.' Nods as she speaks.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。攻める姿勢、章末で論じました。
lines.en: Yes. I discussed an aggressive analytical approach at the end of the chapter.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly formal. Careful precision on each clause. A little rush of relief that he's being understood. Moderate pace, no trailing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 当社の前身、明治期の出版社ですね。
lines.en: And the publisher's history before the war — you grounded it in the Meiji period.
lines.style: Thoughtful, following a thread. Light curiosity in the rise. Engaged but not pressing. Conversational, like she's thinking alongside him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。受験生、模試の結果に振り回されないように、論じました。
lines.en: Right. I wanted to show test-takers how not to get swept up in mock exam results. That's where I positioned it.
lines.style: Focused and earnest. A small hesitation before 'test-takers' — he's aware the scope is broad. Steady delivery. Slightly formal register, like he's explaining his reasoning.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 近世の文学史、別章で扱いましたね。
lines.en: You handled early-modern literary history really carefully — gave it its own chapter.
lines.style: Appreciative, steady. A slight nod of recognition on 'carefully.' Warm without overdoing it. Teacher-like in the best sense — she sees what he's done right.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 廃案になった政策、史料、参考にしました。
lines.en: I used historical sources on policies that were abandoned — they helped ground the argument.
lines.style: Methodical, slightly technical. Proud of his research without boasting. Even pace. A brief, confident pause before 'abandoned.' He knows this was a good choice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 本州全域の文化、丁寧にまとめましたね。
lines.en: The cultural scope across Honshu is really well-synthesized in here.
lines.style: Genuine praise with a touch of surprise at the scale. Warm but measured. Speaks as if she's just noticed something she respects. Calm approval.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 鎖国期の影響、最終章で総括します。
lines.en: I bring it all together in the final chapter — how the sakoku period shaped everything that came after.
lines.style: Confident, looking ahead. Slight emphasis on 'shaped everything' — this is where the argument lands. Measured pace, calm closure. He's thought this through.
